name: Washing machine production line solution
summary: A full-line automation solution for washing machine manufacturers, covering the entire process from assembly to packaging.
contentHtml:
The washing machine production line solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for washing machine manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process including component supply, inner drum assembly, outer shell assembly, electrical installation, vibration damping installation, online inspection, automatic packaging, and intelligent warehousing.

Technical Advantages

  • High degree of full-line automation, reducing manual intervention
  • Flexible multi-model switching with short changeover times
  • Online inspection system ensures product quality
  • Intelligent data collection for lean production
  • Integration with MES for full traceability
  • Turnkey project with one-stop service

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.

painPoints.title: Complex assembly process
painPoints.desc: Washing machine assembly involves multiple components, complex processes, and high difficulty in manual assembly

painPoints.title: Long changeover time
painPoints.desc: Long changeover and debugging time during multi-model production, affecting production capacity

painPoints.title: Numerous inspection items
painPoints.desc: Washing machine has many inspection items, manual inspection is inefficient and prone to missed detection

painPoints.title: Slow material handling
painPoints.desc: Material handling between processes relies on manual labor, making rhythm coordination difficult

painPoints.title: High quality fluctuation
painPoints.desc: Poor consistency in manual operations, unstable product quality

painPoints.title: Difficult data collection
painPoints.desc: Production data is recorded manually, poor real-time performance, difficult to analyze

process.title: Component supply
